      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import { getXataClient } from '@/db/xata/xata';\nimport type { TestimonyData } from '@/types/testimony';\n\nexport async function processTestimony(data: TestimonyData) {\n  const xata = getXataClient();\n  \n  try {\n    // Check for existing testimony\n    const existing = await xata.db.testimonies\n      .filter({ title: data.title })\n      .getFirst();\n\n    if (existing) {\n      // Update existing testimony\n      await xata.db.testimonies.update(existing.id, {\n        summary: data.summary,\n        context: data.context,\n        claim: data.claims?.join('\\n'),\n        source: data.source\n      });\n\n      return {\n        status: 'updated',\n        id: existing.id\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Create new testimony\n    const testimony = await xata.db.testimonies.create({\n      title: data.title,\n      summary: data.summary,\n      context: data.context,\n      claim: data.claims?.join('\\n'),\n      source: data.source\n    });\n\n    // Process related entities\n    if (data.personnel?.length) {\n      for (const person of data.personnel) {\n        const personnelRecord = await xata.db.personnel.create({\n          name: person.name,\n          role: person.role,\n          bio: person.bio,\n          rank: person.authorityMetrics?.rank,\n          credibility: person.authorityMetrics?.credibility\n        });\n\n        // Link personnel as witness\n        await xata.db.testimonies.update(testimony.id, {\n          witness: {\n            id: personnelRecord.id\n          }\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Process events\n    if (data.events?.length) {\n      for (const event of data.events) {\n        const eventRecord = await xata.db.events.create({\n          title: event.title,\n          description: event.description,\n          location: event.location,\n          date: event.date ? new Date(event.date) : undefined\n        });\n\n        // Link event to testimony\n        await xata.db.testimonies.update(testimony.id, {\n          event: {\n            id: eventRecord.id\n          }\n        });\n      }\n    }",

        "originalContents": "import { getXataClient } from '@/db/xata/xata';\nimport type { TestimonyData } from '@/types/testimony';\n\nexport async function processTestimony(data: TestimonyData) {\n  const xata = getXataClient();\n  \n  try {\n    // Check for existing testimony\n    const existing = await xata.db.testimonies\n      .filter({ title: data.title })\n      .getFirst();\n\n    if (existing) {\n      // Update existing testimony\n      await xata.db.testimonies.update(existing.id, {\n        summary: data.summary,\n        context: data.context,\n        claim: data.claims?.join('\\n'),\n        source: data.source\n      });\n\n      return {\n        status: 'updated',\n        id: existing.id\n      };\n    }\n\n    // Create new testimony\n    const testimony = await xata.db.testimonies.create({\n      title: data.title,\n      summary: data.summary,\n      context: data.context,\n      claim: data.claims?.join('\\n'),\n      source: data.source\n    });\n\n    // Process related entities\n    if (data.personnel?.length) {\n      for (const person of data.personnel) {\n        const personnelRecord = await xata.db.personnel.create({\n          name: person.name,\n          role: person.role,\n          bio: person.bio,\n          rank: person.authorityMetrics?.rank,\n          credibility: person.authorityMetrics?.credibility\n        });\n\n        // Link personnel as witness\n        await xata.db.testimonies.update(testimony.id, {\n          witness: {\n            id: personnelRecord.id\n          }\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Process events\n    if (data.events?.length) {\n      for (const event of data.events) {\n        const eventRecord = await xata.db.events.create({\n          title: event.title,\n          description: event.description,\n          location: event.location,\n          date: event.date ? new Date(event.date) : undefined\n        });\n\n        // Link event to testimony\n        await xata.db.testimonies.update(testimony.id, {\n          event: {\n            id: eventRecord.id\n          }\n        });\n      }\n    }",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Main function to import testimonies to Xata\nasync function importTestimoniesToXata(options: { \n  forceImport: boolean;\n  minQualityScore: number;\n  skipDuplicates: boolean;\n  updateExisting: boolean;\n}) {\n  console.log('Initializing Xata client...');\n  const xata = getXataClient();\n  console.log('Xata client initialized successfully.');\n  let successCount = 0;\n  let errorCount = 0;\n  let duplicateCount = 0;\n  let poorQualityCount = 0;\n  let updatedCount = 0;\n  \n  // Find all testimony summary files\n  const summaryFiles = findSummaryFiles();\n  const skippedTestimonies: Array\u003c{ title: string; reason: string }\u003e = [];\n  const qualityReport: Array\u003c{ title: string; score: number; issues: string[] }\u003e = [];\n  \n  console.log(&#96;Found ${summaryFiles.length} testimony summary files&#96;);\n  console.log(&#96;Minimum quality score: ${options.minQualityScore}/100&#96;);\n  console.log(options.forceImport \n    ? \"FORCE IMPORT MODE: Will import even if duplicates are detected\" \n    : (options.skipDuplicates ? \"Normal mode: Will skip duplicates\" : \"Will check duplicates but import anyway\"));",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Check for duplicate testimonies in the database\nasync function checkForDuplicates(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  testimony: TestimonyData\n): Promise\u003c{ isDuplicate: boolean; method: string; existingId?: string }\u003e {\n  // Try to find exact match by title\n  if (testimony.title) {\n    try {\n      const titleMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ title: testimony.title })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (titleMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'exact title match',\n          existingId: titleMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for title duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by YouTube URL\n  if (testimony.youtubeUrl) {\n    try {\n      const urlMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ source: testimony.youtubeUrl })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (urlMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'URL match',\n          existingId: urlMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for URL duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by similarity in key fields\n  try {\n    // Extract a significant phrase from the title\n    const titleFragment = testimony.title.split(' ').slice(0, 3).join(' ');\n    \n    if (titleFragment.length \u003e 10) {\n      const fragmentMatches = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .search(titleFragment, { fuzziness: 1 })\n        .getMany();\n      \n      if (fragmentMatches.length \u003e 0) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'fuzzy title match',\n          existingId: fragmentMatches[0].id\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error checking for similar testimony:', error);\n  }\n  \n  return { isDuplicate: false, method: 'none' };\n}",

        "contents": "async function importTestimoniesToXata(options: { \n  forceImport: boolean;\n  minQualityScore: number;\n  skipDuplicates: boolean;\n  updateExisting: boolean;\n}) {\n  console.log('Initializing Xata client...');\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  // Process each summary file\n  for (const file of summaryFiles) {\n    const fileName = path.basename(file);\n    console.log(&#96;Processing ${fileName}...&#96;);\n    \n    // Parse the summary file\n    const testimony = parseSummaryFile(file);\n    if (!testimony) {\n      console.error(&#96;Failed to parse ${fileName}&#96;);\n      errorCount++;\n      continue;\n    }\n    \n    // Validate the testimony data quality\n    const qualityResult = validateDataQuality(testimony);\n    qualityReport.push({\n      title: testimony.title,\n      score: qualityResult.score,\n      issues: qualityResult.issues\n    });\n    \n    // Skip poor quality testimonies\n    if (!qualityResult.isValid \u0026\u0026 qualityResult.score \u003c options.minQualityScore) {\n      console.log(&#96;Skipping poor quality testimony: ${testimony.title} (quality score: ${qualityResult.score}/100)&#96;);\n      skippedTestimonies.push({\n        title: testimony.title,\n        reason: &#96;Poor quality score: ${qualityResult.score}/100.       "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Create or get a personnel record by name\nasync function createOrGetPersonnel(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  personnel: PersonnelData\n): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Try to find existing personnel by name\n    const existingPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel\n      .filter({ name: personnel.name })\n      .getFirst();\n    \n    if (existingPersonnel) {\n      return existingPersonnel.id;\n    }\n    \n    // Create new personnel record\n    const newPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel.create({\n      name: personnel.name,\n      role: personnel.role,\n      bio: personnel.bio,\n      rank: personnel.authorityMetrics?.rank,\n      credibility: personnel.authorityMetrics?.credibility,\n    });\n    \n    return newPersonnel.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error creating/getting personnel record for ${personnel.name}:&#96;, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

          },

          },

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Create or get a personnel record by name\nasync function createOrGetPersonnel(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  personnel: PersonnelData\n): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Try to find existing personnel by name\n    const existingPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel\n      .filter({ name: personnel.name })\n      .getFirst();\n    \n    if (existingPersonnel) {\n      return existingPersonnel.id;\n    }\n    \n    // Create new personnel record\n    const newPersonnel = await xata.db.personnel.create({\n      name: personnel.name,\n      role: personnel.role,\n      bio: personnel.bio,\n      rank: personnel.authorityMetrics?.rank,\n      credibility: personnel.authorityMetrics?.credibility,\n    });\n    \n    return newPersonnel.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error creating/getting personnel record for ${personnel.name}:&#96;, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Create or get an organization record by name\nasync function createOrGetOrganization(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  organization: OrganizationData\n): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Try to find existing organization by name\n    const existingOrg = await xata.db.organizations\n      .filter({ name: organization.name })\n      .getFirst();\n    \n    if (existingOrg) {\n      return existingOrg.id;\n    }\n    \n    // Create new organization record\n    const newOrg = await xata.db.organizations.create({\n      name: organization.name,\n      title: organization.name,\n      description: organization.description\n    });\n    \n    return newOrg.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error creating/getting organization record for ${organization.name}:&#96;, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Create or get an organization record by name\nasync function createOrGetOrganization(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  organization: OrganizationData\n): Promise\u003cstring | null\u003e {\n  try {\n    // Try to find existing organization by name\n    const existingOrg = await xata.db.organizations\n      .filter({ name: organization.name })\n      .getFirst();\n    \n    if (existingOrg) {\n      return existingOrg.id;\n    }\n    \n    // Create new organization record\n    const newOrg = await xata.db.organizations.create({\n      name: organization.name,\n      title: organization.name,\n      description: organization.description\n    });\n    \n    return newOrg.id;\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error(&#96;Error creating/getting organization record for ${organization.name}:&#96;, error);\n    return null;\n  }\n}",

    {
      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "\n\n// Check for duplicate testimonies in the database\nasync function checkForDuplicates(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  testimony: TestimonyData\n): Promise\u003c{ isDuplicate: boolean; method: string; existingId?: string }\u003e {\n  // Try to find exact match by title\n  if (testimony.title) {\n    try {\n      const titleMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ title: testimony.title })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (titleMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'exact title match',\n          existingId: titleMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for title duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by YouTube URL\n  if (testimony.youtubeUrl) {\n    try {\n      const urlMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ source: testimony.youtubeUrl })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (urlMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'URL match',\n          existingId: urlMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for URL duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by similarity in key fields\n  try {\n    // Extract a significant phrase from the title\n    const titleFragment = testimony.title.split(' ').slice(0, 3).join(' ');\n    \n    if (titleFragment.length \u003e 10) {\n      const fragmentMatches = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .search(titleFragment, { fuzziness: 1 })\n        .getMany();\n      \n      if (fragmentMatches.length \u003e 0) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'fuzzy title match',\n          existingId: fragmentMatches[0].id\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error checking for similar testimony:', error);\n  }\n  \n  return { isDuplicate: false, method: 'none' };\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n// Check for duplicate testimonies in the database\nasync function checkForDuplicates(\n  xata: ReturnType\u003ctypeof getXataClient\u003e, \n  testimony: TestimonyData\n): Promise\u003c{ isDuplicate: boolean; method: string; existingId?: string }\u003e {\n  // Try to find exact match by title\n  if (testimony.title) {\n    try {\n      const titleMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ title: testimony.title })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (titleMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'exact title match',\n          existingId: titleMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for title duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by YouTube URL\n  if (testimony.youtubeUrl) {\n    try {\n      const urlMatch = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .filter({ source: testimony.youtubeUrl })\n        .getFirst();\n      \n      if (urlMatch) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'URL match',\n          existingId: urlMatch.id\n        };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      console.error('Error checking for URL duplicate:', error);\n    }\n  }\n  \n  // Try to find by similarity in key fields\n  try {\n    // Extract a significant phrase from the title\n    const titleFragment = testimony.title.split(' ').slice(0, 3).join(' ');\n    \n    if (titleFragment.length \u003e 10) {\n      const fragmentMatches = await xata.db.testimonies\n        .search(titleFragment, { fuzziness: 1 })\n        .getMany();\n      \n      if (fragmentMatches.length \u003e 0) {\n        return { \n          isDuplicate: true, \n          method: 'fuzzy title match',\n          existingId: fragmentMatches[0].id\n        };\n      }\n    }\n  } catch (error) {\n    console.error('Error checking for similar testimony:', error);\n  }\n  \n  return { isDuplicate: false, method: 'none' };\n}",

        "contents": "\nexport const executePlatformWideConnectionSearch = async ( { id, type }: any ) =\u003e {\n  const tables: any = connectionMapByEntityType[type]\n\n  const { totalCount, records } = await xata.search.all( &#96;${id}&#96;, {\n    tables: tables.map(\n      ( { table, target }: { table: string; target: string } ) =\u003e {\n        return {\n          table: &#96;${table}&#96;,\n          target: [{ column: &#96;${target}&#96;, weight: 10 }],\n        }\n      }\n    ),\n    fuzziness: 0,\n    prefix: 'phrase',\n  } )\n\n  const connectionRecords: Set\u003cany\u003e = new Set()\n\n  for ( const item of records ) {\n    const { record, table } = item\n    if ( table === 'testimonies' ) {\n      console.log( 'record: ', record )\n      const connection: any = await xata.db.testimonies.read( record?.id, ['*', 'event.*', 'witness.*'] )\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: 'testimonies',\n\n          // connectionTable,\n        } )\n\n      }\n    } else {\n      const originalRecordTypeSingular = objectMapToSingular[type]\n      const {\n        record: { xata: xataObject, ...restOfRecord },\n        table: connectionTable,\n      }: any = item\n\n      if (\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular] \u0026\u0026\n        restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular].id === id\n      ) {\n        delete restOfRecord[originalRecordTypeSingular]\n      }\n      const { id: recordId, ...rest } = restOfRecord\n\n      const [connectionType] = Object.keys( rest )\n\n      const table: any = objectMapPlural[connectionType]\n\n      const connectedRecordId = rest[connectionType].id\n\n      const connection: any = await xata.db[table].read( connectedRecordId )\n\n      if ( !connectionRecords.has( connection ) ) {\n        connectionRecords.add( {\n          ...connection,\n          type: table,\n          connectionTableId: recordId,\n          connectionTable,\n        } )\n      }\n\n    }\n\n\n    //  await xata.db[table].read( record?.id )\n    // console.log( 'connection: ', connection )\n\n  }",

        "contents": "\nconst valueBoosters = {\n  events: ['name', 'date', 'location', 'description'],\n  personnel: ( { column, value }: { column: string, value: string } ) =\u003e [{ valueBooster: { column, value, factor: 5 } }],\n  topics: ['name', 'summary'],\n  testimonies: ['claim', 'summary', 'documentation'],\n}\n\nconst processResults = ( records: any ) =\u003e {\n\n  const results = records.map( ( record: any ) =\u003e {\n    const { xata: searchRank, ...rest } = record\n    const { highlight, score, table } = searchRank\n\n    return {\n      highlight,\n      score,\n      record: {\n        ...rest,\n        type: table,\n      }\n    }\n  } )\n\n  const [suggestedSearchResult, ...rest] = results\n  return {\n    suggestedSearchResult,\n    relatedResults: rest\n  }\n}",

+ 		} = {

+ 		};
+ 
+ 		// Add filter if provided

+ 			queryOptions.filter = options.filter;

+ 
+ 		// Add sort if provided
+ 		if (options?.sort) {

+ 				"askTestimonies",
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Use Xata's search capabilities to find relevant testimonies
+ 		const searchResults = await xata.db.testimonies.search(question, {
+ 			fuzziness: 2,
+ 			page: {
+ 				size: options?.maxResults || 5,
+ 			},
+ 		});
+ 
+ 		return {
+ 			answer: &#96;Results for: ${question}&#96;,
+ 			relatedRecords: searchResults.records,

+ export async function getTestimoniesByDateRange(

+

+ 
+ 		return result.records;

        "contents": "\nconst valueBoosters = {\n  events: ['name', 'date', 'location', 'description'],\n  personnel: ( { column, value }: { column: string, value: string } ) =\u003e [{ valueBooster: { column, value, factor: 5 } }],\n  topics: ['name', 'summary'],\n  testimonies: ['claim', 'summary', 'documentation'],\n}\n\nconst processResults = ( records: any ) =\u003e {\n\n  const results = records.map( ( record: any ) =\u003e {\n    const { xata: searchRank, ...rest } = record\n    const { highlight, score, table } = searchRank\n\n    return {\n      highlight,\n      score,\n      record: {\n        ...rest,\n        type: table,\n      }\n    }\n  } )\n\n  const [suggestedSearchResult, ...rest] = results\n  return {\n    suggestedSearchResult,\n    relatedResults: rest\n  }\n}",

+ import { xata } from "@/db/xata/client";
+ import type { Topics, TopicsRecord } from "@/db/xata/xata";
+ import type { ReadOptions } from "@xata.io/client";
+ 
+ /**
+  * Error interface for standardized error responses
+  */
+ interface TopicsOperationError extends Error {
+ 	code: string;
+ 	operation: string;
+ 	details?: unknown;
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Standard response interface for paginated data
+  */
+ interface PaginatedResponse&lt;T&gt; {
+ 	records: T[];
+ 	pagination: {
+ 		page: number;
+ 		size: number;
+ 		total?: number;
+ 		hasNextPage: boolean;
+ 	};
+ }
+ 
+ /**
+  * Creates an error with standardized format for consistent error handling
+  * @param message Error message
+  * @param code Error code
+  * @param operation Operation that caused the error
+  * @param details Additional error details
+  * @returns Standardized error object
+  */
+ function createTopicError(
+ 	message: string,
+ 	code: string,
+ 	operation: string,
+ 	details?: unknown,
+ ): TopicsOperationError {
+ 	const error = new Error(message) as TopicsOperationError;
+ 	error.code = code;
+ 	error.operation = operation;
+ 	error.details = details;
+ 	return error;
+ }
+

+ /**

+ export async function getAllTopics(options?: {
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+ 	sort?: Record&lt;string, "asc" | "desc"&gt;;
+ 	pagination?: { size?: number; offset?: number };
+ 	columns?: string[];
+ 	consistency?: "strong" | "eventual";
+ }): Promise&lt;TopicsRecord[]&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Build the query using builder pattern
+ 		const queryOptions: {
+ 			filter?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+ 			sort?: [string, "asc" | "desc"][];
+ 			columns?: string[];
+ 			pagination?: { size: number; offset: number };
+ 			consistency?: "strong" | "eventual";
+ 		} = {
+ 			consistency: options?.consistency || "strong",
+ 		};
+ 
+ 		// Add filter if provided
+ 		if (options?.filter) {
+ 			queryOptions.filter = options.filter;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Add sort if provided
+ 		if (options?.sort) {
+ 			queryOptions.sort = Object.entries(options.sort).map(
+ 				([column, direction]) =&gt; [column, direction],
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Add columns if provided
+ 		if (options?.columns) {
+ 			queryOptions.columns = options.columns;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Add pagination if provided
+ 		if (options?.pagination) {
+ 			queryOptions.pagination = {
+ 				size: options.pagination.size || 50,
+ 				offset: options.pagination.offset || 0,
+ 			};
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		// Execute query with all options
+ 		const result = await xata.db.topics.query(queryOptions);

+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error getting all topics:", error);

+ /**
+  * Get topic records with pagination

+  * @param filter Optional filter criteria

+  * @returns Paginated topic records
+  * @throws {TopicsOperationError} If pagination query fails
+  */
+ export async function getTopicsWithPagination(
+ 	page = 1,
+ 	size = 20,
+ 	filter?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;,
+ 	columns?: string[],
+ ): Promise&lt;PaginatedResponse&lt;TopicsRecord&gt;&gt; {
+ 	try {
+ 		// Validate input
+ 		if (page &lt; 1) {
+ 			throw createTopicError(
+ 				"Page number must be greater than 0",
+ 				"INVALID_PAGE",
+ 				"getTopicsWithPagination",
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		if (size &lt; 1 || size &gt; 100) {
+ 			throw createTopicError(
+ 				"Page size must be between 1 and 100",
+ 				"INVALID_SIZE",
+ 				"getTopicsWithPagination",
+ 			);
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const queryOptions: {
+ 			filter?: Record&lt;string, unknown&gt;;
+ 			columns?: string[];
+ 			pagination: { size: number; offset: number };
+ 		} = {
+ 			pagination: {
+ 				size,
+ 				offset: (page - 1) * size,
+ 			},
+ 		};
+ 
+ 		if (filter) {
+ 			queryOptions.filter = filter;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		if (columns) {
+ 			queryOptions.columns = columns;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		const result = await xata.db.topics.query(queryOptions);
+ 
+ 		return {
+ 			records: result.records,
+ 			pagination: {
+ 				page,
+ 				size,
+ 				total: result.meta?.page?.more
+ 					? undefined // We can't determine the exact total when there are more records
+ 					: (page - 1) * size + result.records.length,
+ 				hasNextPage: result.meta?.page?.more || false,
+ 			},
+ 		};
+ 	} catch (error) {
+ 		console.error("Error getting paginated topics:", error);
+ 
+ 		if ((error as TopicsOperationError).code) {
+ 			throw error;
+ 		}
+ 
+ 		throw createTopicError(

+ 			"PAGINATION_FAILED",
+ 			"getTopicsWithPagination",
+ 			error,
+ 		);
+ 	}
+ }
